name: io.github.mutonby/aikount-mcp
description: Agent-first Spanish accounting (Aikount): issue invoices, ingest expense PDFs, reconcile bank movements and prepare Modelo 303 over the public REST API.

environment_variables.name: AIKOUNT_TOKEN
environment_variables.description: Long-lived Aikount API key (scope *), prefixed agl_. Mint it from the web app's 'Conectar agente' button.

environment_variables.name: AIKOUNT_API
environment_variables.description: API base URL. Defaults to https://api.aikount.com/api/v1; override for staging/self-hosted.
